data_scope: NQ 1-minute Databento archive futures/nq/data/NQ_1m_clean.parquet, 2011-08-01 to 2026-07-15, 3,842 Asia sessions; the article's own 2021-12-01 to 2025-08-31 window reported as a separate row. All historical data is inspected by this project — only future observations are clean holdout.
primary_metric: per-signal mean gross forward return in index points with a trade-date cluster-robust t (Rule 12); net reported on a five-rung cost ladder (0.000 / 0.335 / 1.100 / 1.350 / 2.000 points round trip).
result_summary: The article's T=-10.96 is a COST statistic, not a signal statistic. Coin-flip direction on identical bars/fills/charge (400 draws) prints net t -15.18 [-17.33,-13.05] on the article window -- MORE negative than -10.96. Continuation gross t +0.50 on the same sample. Confirms the source's trading conclusion while rejecting its stated directional mechanism.
